item.title: Armstrong tops Tuesday morning times at Sebring IndyCar test
item.description: Meyer Shank Racing ended Monday afternoon’s IndyCar Series test on top with Marcus Armstrong in the No. 66 Honda, and the New Zealander didn’t lose a step overnight after leading the group of 12 Tuesday morning runners at Sebring International Raceway.

item.title: Chevrolet, Honda expected to continue as IndyCar engine suppliers beyond 2026
item.description: Years of speculation about the future of IndyCar's current engine partners is expected to end in the coming days with the formal confirmation that Honda and Chevrolet have both signed contract extensions.
